title: Design: Internal work order three-dots menu has no invoice or deposit items
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a new internal work order for that customer and asset, with one labor line (1.0 h) and one stock part with a cost (for example $95.00), the line In Progress, made for this test.
  • Make sure the organization does not require review before completion.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow1-09-3c-menu-internal.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the internal work order.
  2. Click the three-dots menu in the header.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens with the line In Progress.

Step 2:

  • The menu holds "Close Work Order" where Create invoice would be.
  • It has no "Send to Portal", "Request IBS Approval", "Add Deposit" or "Add Work Order Fee / Discount".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-N2: “With review off and open lines, Close Work Order sits in the three-dots menu exactly as Create invoice does today; once every line is Complete it is the header button and leaves the menu, as Create invoice does.”
  • S2-R11: “On an internal work order "Send to Portal" and "Request IBS Approval" are not shown.”
  • S2-N5: “"Add Deposit" is not shown on internal and no-charge work orders.”
  • S2-R15: “When a work order becomes internal or no charge, its work order fees and discounts and its line discounts are removed with the prices, and "Add Work Order Fee / Discount" is not shown in its menu.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: page "Flow 1 · Create and close", board "3c Menu · internal" (Flow 1 · Create and close).

  • iwo-flow1-09-3c-menu-internal.png
